instruction: A candid outdoor full shot captures a group of friends on a grassy park field during the day. On the right, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) stands facing left, clapping with a focused expression. To his left, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt (R4) leans forward with clenched fists, looking intently to the left. In the background, the man in a red polo shirt (R3) stands on the left, while the woman in a red t-shirt and black beanie (R5) is partially visible behind the bald man (R2). They stand closely, reacting to an off-camera event. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight with soft shadows on the green grass.
